quest.title: Garcia's Paean: Easy Peasy
quest.description: Garcia seems to be sweating over something at the blacksmith...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: My hands... Ugh! They're both numb...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Sir, you still need to do accounts for Ms. Kaia later. Please don't exhaust yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Not right now, Lutong! I—I am well aware!

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Of course, if you can't make it, I will stand in for you.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: No! I will do that myself. I am just... I just need to... forge a couple more gears...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Okay, I give up, I just can't continue anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing now...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, Traveler... Ouch... My hands...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Well, here's the situation. Mr. Ahangar is also otherwise engaged, and so it is not possible to constantly commission him to make the parts I need...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Moreover, the parts he makes are often ever so slightly different from those that I picture in my mind.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: So, to ensure the reliability of these parts, I asked Mr. Ahangar to teach me some forging skills and decided to forge the parts on my own.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Fortunately, I have acquired relevant experience in Fontaine... But some of the techniques Mr. Ahangar spoke of were just so hard to remember. Ouch...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you please ask Mr. Ahangar about his forging techniques? I really need some rest...

choices.text: Have a good rest here, Mr. Garcia.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Thank you for being willing to help. Ugh... My hands...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: A business partner! A... um... very talented and... rich business partner!

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: We have signed a long-term accounting contract with her! And that is why I've been meeting her often, as I'm certain Lutong can attest to.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: That is perfectly right, sir.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: S—So that's how things stand... Traveler, do help us find Mr. Ahangar as soon as possible. I shall be waiting here.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: I told you! Just wait a sec... Huh. It's you.

choices.text: I'm here to ask some questions on Mr. Garcia's behalf.

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: So he actually went and did that himself... What a weirdo.

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: I've been a blacksmith for a great many years. This is the first time I've encountered someone with such strict requirements.

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: He even brings a ruler to measure the seam between iron tubes, and the distance between threads.

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: I just can't put up with him, so I told him to do it himself... And you know what? He actually came the next day and asked me to teach him some forging skills.

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: Really, there's nothing I can do about him, so I let him be. As long as he pays for the materials, I'll let him use whatever tools he wants.

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: *sigh* I've no idea what this guy has in mind...

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: Eh, it's probably something strange, whatever it is. You're here to ask about forging skills, right? To be honest, I have nothing much to teach regarding gear forging...

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: I have noticed something about the gears he wants, though. They all have sharp edges but are concave in the middle...

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: Molds are not enough for such specially-shaped gears, so he has to reshape the gears afterward.

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: I've taught him about the techniques in detail. You just need to tell him...

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: First, <color=#00E1FFFF>remember to add enough fuel to really heat up the fire</color> when putting it into the furnace for the second time.

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: Then, when you take it out to process it, <color=#00E1FFFF>hammer it from the inside out</color>.

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: Did you get all that? Alright, go back and tell him if you did.

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: What a weirdo...

choices.text: Mr. Garcia's hands went numb from all that forging, and he needs rest.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Garcia begins his work...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Aha! Success! This gear looks mighty fine, if I should say so myself!

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: The spacing between its teeth... Thickness... Size... Ah, I must fetch a ruler...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: It's best that we leave Mr. Garcia to his measurements. Traveler, here is your payment. Please take it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you still... cautiously pessimistic?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Yes, that's how I have always been.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Mr. Garcia and I have been wandering in front of a giant mountain for some time now, and we have only just removed a tiny stone from the foot of this mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: We have, in truth, not yet found a way up.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Hopefully, Mr. Garcia's talents will lead us to the right path...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Or I will have to tell myself that "when your path is blocked by a mountain, there will be a way through."

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Lutong! This gear is ready for demolding! Come help me!

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Traveler, you're back. So, Mr. Ahangar has taught you his tricks, I trust?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Tell me then, how should I process this gear?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When sending the parts into the furnace again, remember to add more fuel.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When sending the parts into the furnace again, don't add more fuel.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When sending the parts into the furnace again, remember to add less fuel.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Garcia begins his work...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Alright, this gear has been heated up... What next?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hammer it in the middle and work your way out to the edges.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hammer it around the edges and work your way into the middle.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hammer it in the middle real hard.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Garcia begins his work...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Um... The gear doesn't quite... look right.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: It's okay, we'll start over... Traveler, what should I take into consideration?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Sir, I humbly suggest that we might have to... change our approach.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Change our approach?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Perhaps we might make something less complicated but equally intricate.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: I believe that with your talents, making machines of this sort should be...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: My dear Lutong, we have spoken of this matter before. You know my answer... but I will always respect your choices.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Perhaps we should instead discuss where you shall have dinner with Ms. Kaia next, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Ah, thank you, Lutong.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: My pleasure, sir. Our contract has not ended yet.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Do you have other questions for me?

choices.text: Has Garcia been here for long?

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: Quite some time, I would say. This guy is even more passionate than some of my apprentices.

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: But he just doesn't look like someone who wants to make a living as a blacksmith...

choices.text: Did anyone visit them other than me?

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: Hmm... There is a woman who visits him quite often, and she comes bringing lots of things.

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: He has told me that the woman is named Kaia... Or something like that.

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: I don't get it. These people look nothing like blacksmiths, so why do they hang around in my smithy...

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: What on earth does this guy have in his mind...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: (The gear's dimensions should be... Kaia helped me record them last time... Ugh! What is WRONG with me!?)

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: (Maybe I should go talk to Ms. Kaia...)
